title: Materials
doc: Surface materials: the texture name prefixes that select each material, physical properties and impact sound counts.

sections.name: #Materials
sections.doc: List of materials; each starts at $name: and the list ends at #End.

fields.name: $bitmap prefix:
fields.doc: Texture file name prefix that selects this material; repeat for several.

fields.name: $elasticity:
fields.doc: Bounce of objects hitting the material.

fields.name: $bouyancy:
fields.doc: Buoyancy (the marker is spelled this way).

fields.name: $traction:
fields.doc: Grip when walking or driving on it.

fields.name: $debris bitmap:
fields.doc: Texture for debris of this material; "" for none.

sections.name: #Material Hit Sounds
sections.doc: A 10 by 10 grid: a header row of 10 quoted material names, then 10 rows of a quoted material name and 10 counts of impact sounds; no #End is read.

cell.doc: number of impact sound variations for the pair
